newFunctions.name: _buildWrongChoiceCoaching(question, context)
newFunctions.purpose: Builds structured misconception coaching for each wrong answer using ExplanationWrong + inference

returns.choices: Array of coaching objects with choiceLabel, choiceText, whyTempting, whyWrong, misconception, avoidNextTime, sourceExplanationIncluded, safeFallbackUsed, isSelectedAnswer
returns.selectedFirst: boolean — whether selected wrong answer is prioritized
returns.allSelectionSafe: boolean — whether context permits full option reveal

newFunctions.name: _inferWhyTempting(q, choiceLetter, choiceText, topic, isCalculation)
newFunctions.purpose: Infers why a distractor plausibly looks correct — stem/choice overlap, calculation trap, or common distractor pattern detection

newFunctions.name: _inferWhyWrongFallback(q, choiceLetter, choiceText, topic, correctText)
newFunctions.purpose: Safe fallback for why-wrong when ExplanationWrong is thin — grounded in topic, no fabrication

newFunctions.name: _inferMisconception(q, choiceLetter, choiceText, topic, wrongExp, isCalculation)
newFunctions.purpose: Infers the conceptual error behind choosing this option — extracts from ExplanationWrong signals or uses section-aligned misconception patterns

newFunctions.name: _inferAvoidNextTime(q, choiceLetter, topic, section, isCalculation)
newFunctions.purpose: Section-specific pattern-recognition tip for avoiding this trap in future questions
